vertebrae.reports.recommendations
=================================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.reports.recommendations

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Simple recommendation rules for benchmark reports.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.reports.recommendations.recommendation_for_extractor
   vertebrae.reports.recommendations.recommendations_for_benchmark


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: recommendation_for_extractor(macro_score, stability, weakest_class_score)

   Compute a recommendation label for one extractor.

   :param macro_score: Global OverlapIndex score.
   :param stability: Optional stability summary.
   :param weakest_class_score: Lowest per-class score when available.

   :returns: Recommendation label string.


.. py:function:: recommendations_for_benchmark(extractor_results)

   Compute practitioner-facing recommendations for a benchmark.

   :param extractor_results: Evaluated extractor results.

   :returns: Recommendation messages for the report executive summary.
